module Transpiled

import JSON

struct TracebackType end

const TYPE_CHECKING = false

abstract type AbstractCerebras end
abstract type AbstractAsyncCerebras end

_T = Any

mutable struct ServerSentEvent
    _event::Union{Nothing,String}
    _data::String
    _id::Union{Nothing,String}
    _retry::Union{Nothing,Int}
    function ServerSentEvent(; event::Union{Nothing,String}=nothing, data::Union{Nothing,String}=nothing, id::Union{Nothing,String}=nothing, retry::Union{Nothing,Int}=nothing)
        data_str = data === nothing ? "" : String(data)
        new(event, data_str, id, retry)
    end
end

event(x::ServerSentEvent) = x._event
id(x::ServerSentEvent) = x._id
retry(x::ServerSentEvent) = x._retry
data(x::ServerSentEvent) = x._data
json(x::ServerSentEvent) = JSON.parse(data(x))
Base.show(io::IO, x::ServerSentEvent) = print(io, "ServerSentEvent(event=$(event(x)), data=$(data(x)), id=$(id(x)), retry=$(retry(x)))")

mutable struct SSEDecoder
    _data::Vector{String}
    _event::Union{Nothing,String}
    _retry::Union{Nothing,Int}
    _last_event_id::Union{Nothing,String}
    function SSEDecoder()
        new(String[], nothing, nothing, nothing)
    end
end

function iter_bytes(dec::SSEDecoder, iterator)
    return Channel{ServerSentEvent}(ctype -> begin
        for chunk in _iter_chunks(dec, iterator)
            for raw_line in split(String(take!(IOBuffer(chunk))), r"\r?\n"; keepempty=false)
                line = raw_line
                sse = decode(dec, line)
                if sse !== nothing
                    put!(ctype, sse)
                end
            end
        end
        close(ctype)
    end)
end

function _iter_chunks(dec::SSEDecoder, iterator)
    return Channel{Vector{UInt8}}(ctype -> begin
        data = UInt8[]
        for chunk in iterator
            for line in eachsplit(Vector{UInt8}(chunk), UInt8('\n'); keepempty=true)
                append!(data, line)
                if endswith(String(data), "\r\r") || endswith(String(data), "\n\n") || endswith(String(data), "\r\n\r\n")
                    put!(ctype, copy(data))
                    empty!(data)
                end
                push!(data, UInt8('\n'))
            end
        end
        if !isempty(data)
            put!(ctype, data)
        end
        close(ctype)
    end)
end

function aiter_bytes(dec::SSEDecoder, iterator)
    return iter_bytes(dec, iterator)
end

function _aiter_chunks(dec::SSEDecoder, iterator)
    return _iter_chunks(dec, iterator)
end

function decode(dec::SSEDecoder, line::String)::Union{Nothing,ServerSentEvent}
    if isempty(line)
        if dec._event === nothing && isempty(dec._data) && dec._last_event_id === nothing && dec._retry === nothing
            return nothing
        end
        sse = ServerSentEvent(event=dec._event, data=join(dec._data, "\n"), id=dec._last_event_id, retry=dec._retry)
        dec._event = nothing
        empty!(dec._data)
        dec._retry = nothing
        return sse
    end
    if startswith(line, ":")
        return nothing
    end
    fieldname, value = begin
        idx = findfirst(==(':'), line)
        if idx === nothing
            line, ""
        else
            f = line[1:prevind(line, idx)]
            v = line[nextind(line, idx):end]
            f, v
        end
    end
    if startswith(value, " ")
        value = value[2:end]
    end
    if fieldname == "event"
        dec._event = value
    elseif fieldname == "data"
        push!(dec._data, value)
    elseif fieldname == "id"
        if occursin("\0", value)
        else
            dec._last_event_id = value
        end
    elseif fieldname == "retry"
        try
            dec._retry = parse(Int, value)
        catch e
        end
    else
    end
    return nothing
end

abstract type AbstractSSEBytesDecoder end

function iter_bytes(dec::AbstractSSEBytesDecoder, iterator) end
function aiter_bytes(dec::AbstractSSEBytesDecoder, iterator) end

mutable struct Stream{T}
    response
    _decoder::AbstractSSEBytesDecoder
    _cast_to::DataType
    _client::AbstractCerebras
    _iterator
    function Stream{T}(; cast_to::DataType, response, client)::Stream{T} where {T}
        obj = new{T}()
        obj.response = response
        obj._cast_to = cast_to
        obj._client = client
        obj._decoder = client._make_sse_decoder()
        obj._iterator = __stream__(obj)
        obj
    end
end

function Base.iterate(s::Stream)
    iterate(s._iterator)
end

function Base.iterate(s::Stream, state)
    iterate(s._iterator, state)
end

function _iter_events(s::Stream)
    return iter_bytes(s._decoder, s.response_iter_bytes())
end

function __stream__(s::Stream)
    return Channel{Any}(ctype -> begin
        cast_to = s._cast_to
        response = s.response
        process_data = s._client._process_response_data
        iterator = _iter_events(s)
        for sse in iterator
            if startswith(data(sse), "[DONE]")
                break
            end
            if event(sse) === nothing
                d = json(sse)
                if isa(d, Dict) && haskey(d, "error")
                    message = nothing
                    errorv = d["error"]
                    if isa(errorv, Dict)
                        message = get(errorv, "message", nothing)
                    end
                    if !(message isa String) || message === nothing
                        message = "An error occurred during streaming"
                    end
                    err = s._client._make_status_error(message; body=d, response=response)
                    throw(err)
                end
                put!(ctype, process_data(; data=d, cast_to=cast_to, response=response))
            else
                d = json(sse)
                if event(sse) == "error" && isa(d, Dict) && haskey(d, "error")
                    message = nothing
                    errorv = d["error"]
                    if isa(errorv, Dict)
                        message = get(errorv, "message", nothing)
                    end
                    if !(message isa String) || message === nothing
                        message = "An error occurred during streaming"
                    end
                    err = s._client._make_status_error(message; body=d, response=response)
                    throw(err)
                end
                put!(ctype, process_data(; data=Dict("data"=>d, "event"=>event(sse)), cast_to=cast_to, response=response))
            end
        end
        for _sse in iterator
        end
        close(ctype)
    end)
end

function Base.enter(s::Stream)
    s
end

function Base.exit(s::Stream, exc_type, exc, exc_tb)::Nothing
    close(s)
    nothing
end

function close(s::Stream)::Nothing
    s.response_close()
    nothing
end

mutable struct AsyncStream{T}
    response
    _decoder::AbstractSSEBytesDecoder
    _cast_to::DataType
    _client::AbstractAsyncCerebras
    _iterator
    function AsyncStream{T}(; cast_to::DataType, response, client)::AsyncStream{T} where {T}
        obj = new{T}()
        obj.response = response
        obj._cast_to = cast_to
        obj._client = client
        obj._decoder = client._make_sse_decoder()
        obj._iterator = __astream__(obj)
        obj
    end
end

function __anext__(s::AsyncStream)
    iterate(s._iterator)
end

function __aiter__(s::AsyncStream)
    s._iterator
end

function _aiter_events(s::AsyncStream)
    return aiter_bytes(s._decoder, s.response_aiter_bytes())
end

function __astream__(s::AsyncStream)
    return Channel{Any}(ctype -> begin
        cast_to = s._cast_to
        response = s.response
        process_data = s._client._process_response_data
        iterator = _aiter_events(s)
        for sse in iterator
            if startswith(data(sse), "[DONE]")
                break
            end
            if event(sse) === nothing
                d = json(sse)
                if isa(d, Dict) && haskey(d, "error")
                    message = nothing
                    errorv = d["error"]
                    if isa(errorv, Dict)
                        message = get(errorv, "message", nothing)
                    end
                    if !(message isa String) || message === nothing
                        message = "An error occurred during streaming"
                    end
                    err = s._client._make_status_error(message; body=d, response=response)
                    throw(err)
                end
                put!(ctype, process_data(; data=d, cast_to=cast_to, response=response))
            else
                d = json(sse)
                if event(sse) == "error" && isa(d, Dict) && haskey(d, "error")
                    message = nothing
                    errorv = d["error"]
                    if isa(errorv, Dict)
                        message = get(errorv, "message", nothing)
                    end
                    if !(message isa String) || message === nothing
                        message = "An error occurred during streaming"
                    end
                    err = s._client._make_status_error(message; body=d, response=response)
                    throw(err)
                end
                put!(ctype, process_data(; data=Dict("data"=>d, "event"=>event(sse)), cast_to=cast_to, response=response))
            end
        end
        for _sse in iterator
        end
        close(ctype)
    end)
end

function __aenter__(s::AsyncStream)
    s
end

function __aexit__(s::AsyncStream, exc_type, exc, exc_tb)::Nothing
    close(s)
    nothing
end

function close(s::AsyncStream)::Nothing
    s.response_aclose()
    nothing
end

function is_stream_class_type(typ)::Bool
    origin = typ
    return origin <: Stream || origin <: AsyncStream
end

function extract_stream_chunk_type(stream_cls; failure_message::Union{Nothing,String}=nothing)
    StreamT = Stream
    AsyncStreamT = AsyncStream
    return extract_type_var_from_base(stream_cls; index=0, generic_bases=(StreamT, AsyncStreamT), failure_message=failure_message)
end

end
